t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There is no strategy, its down to luck and an algorithm!

vb_textbox.text: Choose left gnome for x1 and right gnome for x5.  Be quick in your response as I timed out a few times! I don't know if there is logic to the game? The gnomes were different colours and the basket was sometimes red or yellow but there didn't seem to be a pattern.  My strategy was just to keep choosing left gnome for x1 and right gnome for x5 and that seemed to gain me a high score. Good Luck!
